<!--
When creating or updating a pull request:
- Assign it to the authenticated GitHub account: gh pr edit <pr> --add-assignee @me.
- List the repository's existing labels with gh label list, read their descriptions,
  and apply the relevant label or labels with gh pr edit <pr> --add-label "<label>".
  Use existing labels only. If none fit, mention that in your handoff instead of creating a label.
- Complete the sections below and omit instructional comments from the published description.
-->

# Summary

# Screenshots

For UI changes, capture relevant screenshots and upload them with gh pr edit <pr> --attach <file>.
Include a short caption for each screenshot and state whether it uses live or mock data.
For changes without a visual impact, write "Not applicable".
-->
